preservation_rule: sorted delete-key map remains typed and scoped by lexicon, language, configuration, and source fingerprint
spell frequencies remain sorted metadata owned by the originating immutable lexicon
exact token digests remain byte-preserving and scoped to the originating value and range
typed rolling tuple remains a candidate fingerprint and is never token identity
exact range digest remains an explicitly encoded byte value
sorted frequency fold remains value-scoped derived metadata, never token identity
